# Volume 3 timeline

## Chapter I The Shadow of Change

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde reflect on past times and their upcoming departures while resting after gathering apples. Afterwards, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) meets Hugh at the bridge, where his affectionate gesture makes her uncomfortable and prompts her to head home. At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts young [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), who questions her about leaving for college.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

**[Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Milty Gammon](../character/milty-gammon.md)** — [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) questions [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about why she is leaving for college and brings up Mrs. Gammon's gossip about her wanting to catch a husband. After sending [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to bed, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walks down to [Victoria Island](../codex/places.md#victoria-island) to sit alone and lose herself in peaceful daydreams.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P45](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0045), [v3 ch.Change P49](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0049), [v3 ch.Change P60](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0060), [v3 ch.Change P61](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0061)_

## Chapter II Garlands of Autumn

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md), [Carrie Mott](../character/carrie-mott.md), [Elias Purdy MacKinnon](../character/elias-purdy-mackinnon.md), [Flossie Tulk](../character/flossie-tulk.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Tibby Tulk](../character/tibby-tulk.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh attend a farewell gathering hosted by the B.V.I.S., where they receive send-off gifts. After feeling discouraged by local opinions about her upcoming college attendance, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes for a walk through the woods with Hugh, finding a wild apple tree and enjoying a quiet walk home along [Linger Lane](../codex/places.md#linger-lane).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Autumn P1](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0001), [v3 ch.Autumn P5](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0005), [v3 ch.Autumn P11](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0011), [v3 ch.Autumn P31](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0031)_

## Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

**[Ada](../character/ada.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hannah](../character/hannah.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) departs from [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) after emotional goodbyes, traveling by train and ferry alongside Hugh and Wilfred. Upon arriving in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris), she is greeted by [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), who escorts her to their new boardinghouse while chatting to brighten Nell's spirits.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P0](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0000), [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

## Chapter IV April’s Lady

**[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Sukey Pullen](../character/sukey-pullen.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md)** — After enrolling at [Wexcombe College](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit [Old St](../codex/places.md#old-st). John's Cemetery to escape their feelings of insignificance. While exploring the historic tombstones, they encounter [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), another lonely student, and quickly form a warm friendship with her.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 ch.Lady P11](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0011), [v3 ch.Lady P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 ch.Lady P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)_

**[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) chat with [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) in the cemetery about her origin, indecisiveness, potential suitors, and reasons for attending [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college). After inspecting a historic midshipman's grave, they bid [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) farewell and discuss their positive impressions of her on their way home.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Lady P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 ch.Lady P54](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0054), [v3 ch.Lady P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 ch.Lady P69](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0069)_

## Chapter V Letters from Home

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) settle into college life at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), aided by Cressida Lindsay's social influence while [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) earns respect as Freshman Class president. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives a stack of letters from home containing updates from [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and news from her friends and family, including humorous local stories from Mrs. Sowerby.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007), [v3 ch.Home P10](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0010)_

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reads letters from home detailing news and gossip from Mrs. Sowerby and [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md). Mrs. Sowerby writes about her daily routine and Robin's misbehavior, while Robin's letter shares local news, mischief, and his curious questions.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P11](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0011), [v3 ch.Home P16](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0016), [v3 ch.Home P17](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0017), [v3 ch.Home P18](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0018)_

## Chapter VI In the Park

**[Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Cressida Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) joins [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), Hugh, and Wilfred on a walk through the park and along [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). During their walk, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) share a quiet conversation about life and grief before the group stops to admire a quaint, historic cottage called Tabby's Place.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Park P8](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0008), [v3 ch.Park P14](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0014), [v3 ch.Park P21](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0021), [v3 ch.Park P32](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0032)_

## Chapter VII Home Again

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns home to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday, where she is warmly welcomed by Isolde, [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), Mrs. Sowerby, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md). Before bed, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) confesses his desire to use a bad word he heard from a hired boy, and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gently helps him overcome his conflict. On [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives letters from [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and Cressida, sharing their news and humorous stories.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034), [v3 ch.Again P47](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0047)_

**[Belinda](../character/belinda.md), [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md)** — After recounting a story about losing and finding streetcar fare, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde visit [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage) for a day outing. They open the house, reminisce about [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md), test the echoes with an old horn, and head home after sunset.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P57](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0057), [v3 ch.Again P58](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0058), [v3 ch.Again P59](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0059), [v3 ch.Again P60](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0060)_

## Chapter VIII Nell’s First Proposal

**[Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md)** — In bed on New Year's Eve, [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) proposes marriage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on behalf of her bashful brother, [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) firmly declines the proposal, causing [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) to react with cool indifference and note that [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) will likely marry [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md) instead. After [Odette](../character/odette-pullen.md) leaves the next morning, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) laughs over the unromantic reality of her very first marriage proposal.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P16](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0016), [v3 ch.Proposal P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 ch.Proposal P25](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0025)_

## Chapter IX An Unwelcome Lover and a Welcome Friend

**[Ada](../character/ada.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Nettie Scobie](../character/nettie-scobie.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) completes her term at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college) while managing persistent suitors, including an unpleasant proposal from [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md). She receives a letter from her friend [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) proposing that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md), and [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) lease a house together for the upcoming school year. After searching without success, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) stumble upon a 'To Let' sign on Tabby's Place in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P1](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0001), [v3 ch.Friend P2](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0002), [v3 ch.Friend P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029)_

**[Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) reflect on their time in [Portmaris](../codex/places.md#portmaris) while walking back via [Linden Avenue](../codex/places.md#linden-avenue). As they pass Tabby's Place, they discover a "To Let" sign and decide to inquire about renting it the following day despite Honora's doubts about the cost.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Friend P27](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0027), [v3 ch.Friend P29](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0029), [v3 ch.Friend P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031), [v3 ch.Friend P32](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0032)_

## Chapter X Tabby’s Place

**[Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Maria](../character/maria.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Tabby](../character/tabby.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit Tabby's Place and successfully arrange to rent the cottage from Miss Tabby Linden and her niece [Maria](../character/maria.md) for the upcoming school year. Later that night, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) visits their room and enthusiastically begs to join them as a housemate, to which [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) agree pending Mabel's consent.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059)_

**[Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) informs [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) of the visiting rules for Tabby's Place, which [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) happily accepts. After [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) departs, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) discuss how adding [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) to their group will help financially and express optimism about living together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P56](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0056), [v3 ch.Place P61](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0061), [v3 ch.Place P64](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0064), [v3 ch.Place P65](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0065)_

## Chapter XI The Round of Life

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Aunt Drusilla](../character/aunt-drusilla.md), [Barney Pullen](../character/barney-pullen.md), [Herb Tranter](../character/herb-tranter.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) and observes subtle changes around town, including [Barney](../character/barney-pullen.md) Pullen's marriage and Odette's plan to move West. She learns from Mrs. Sowerby that her friend [Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md) is gravely ill with consumption. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Isolde drop off jelly at Aunt Drusilla's home, enduring her unpleasant remarks before continuing on to visit Opal, while [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confides her secret ambition to write a story.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000), [v3 ch.Life P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 ch.Life P21](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0021), [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042)_

**[Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) confides in Isolde about her ambition to write and publish a story. Later, they visit Opal Pettigrew's illuminated house, where Opal shows off her summer dresses to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and chats about her suitors. Despite Opal's claims of being in good health, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) notices a troubling look in her eyes before Opal abruptly ushers her downstairs.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Life P42](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0042), [v3 ch.Life P52](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0052), [v3 ch.Life P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053), [v3 ch.Life P58](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0058)_

## Chapter XII “Evadne’s Atonement”

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) writes a story titled 'Evadne's Atonement', sharing her process and drafts with Isolde and seeking feedback from Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Both offer critiques on her plot, characters, and descriptions, though [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) keeps her writing hidden from Hugh and [Aunt Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md). After mailing the manuscript to two different magazines, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives rejections from both and decides to give up her literary ambitions, despite Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) encouraging her to keep writing about what she knows.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Atonement” P28](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0028), [v3 ch.Atonement” P41](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0041), [v3 ch.Atonement” P60](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0060), [v3 ch.Atonement” P67](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0067)_

## Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md)** — Rebellious over Mrs. Sowerby's strict rules, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) throws away his collection money, forces [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to skip Sunday School, and goes fishing with the Cotton children instead. After returning home and telling a series of lies to Mrs. Sowerby to cover up his absence, [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) is overcome with guilt and tearfully confesses his misdeeds to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) late that night.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P21](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0021), [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P58](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0058), [v3 ch.Transgressors P94](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0094)_

**[Lucy](../character/lucy.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns weary to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and is woken up by a distressed [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md). [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) tearfully confesses his misdeeds of the day, including skipping Sunday School, lying, and cursing, fearing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) will dislike him. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) comforts him, explains the concept of conscience, and encourages him to ask for God's forgiveness, which [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) does before finally leaving her to sleep.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P79](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0079), [v3 ch.Transgressors P83](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0083), [v3 ch.Transgressors P94](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0094), [v3 ch.Transgressors P118](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0118)_

## Chapter XIV The Summons

**[Opal Pettigrew](../character/opal-pettigrew.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [God](../character/god.md), [Herb Tranter](../character/herb-tranter.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) sits in the garden with Opal, who tearfully confesses her fear of dying and her unfulfilled desires for her life. Shortly after, Opal passes away peacefully in her sleep. Following the funeral, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Isolde, and [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) walk home discussing death and the afterlife.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Summons P7](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0007), [v3 ch.Summons P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 ch.Summons P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 ch.Summons P35](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0035)_

## Chapter XV A Dream Turned Upside Down

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) disdains the idea of writing a story for a baking powder contest while chatting with Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md). Later, Isolde excitedly reveals that she secretly submitted Nell's story with her own edits and won the prize money. Devastated by the compromise of her artistic ideals, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) hides the check in tears, though [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) later arrives and offers a pragmatic perspective to soothe her humiliation.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Down P7](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0007), [v3 ch.Down P11](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0011), [v3 ch.Down P22](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0022), [v3 ch.Down P35](../source/v03-c15.md#nw-v03-c15-p0035)_

## Chapter XVI Adjusted Relationships

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Smudge](../character/smudge.md)** — At dusk in Tabby's Place, [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) admires the cozy living room where everyone has gathered. Over the past three weeks, the girls and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) have settled comfortably into their new home after setting up their household furnishings.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P1](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0001)_

**[Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Smudge](../character/smudge.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) claims [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) as her cat after Cressy's attempt to kill him fails. [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) arrives with her two cats, [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), and reassures the girls that she will not strictly supervise them. After initial skirmishes among the cats, [Smudge](../character/smudge.md) and [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) eventually become close companions.

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then reads a humorous letter aloud from [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), sharing news, anecdotes, and curious questions from back home before the group returns to their evening studies.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Robin P0](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0000), [v3 ch.Robin P3](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0003), [v3 ch.Robin P5](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0005), [v3 ch.Robin P6](../source/v03-c17.md#nw-v03-c17-p0006)_

## Chapter XVIII Miss Lavinia Remembers the Nell-girl

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends a lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holiday trapped at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) by severe snowstorms, feeling awkward during visits from Hugh and worrying about her ability to afford her continued studies. Her mood turns around when Mr. [Pettifer](../character/pettifer.md) delivers the mail, including news that [Aunt Lavinia](../character/aunt-lavinia.md) [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) has left her a one-thousand-dollar bequest in her will.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Nell-girl P2](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0002), [v3 ch.Nell-girl P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 ch.Nell-girl P21](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0021), [v3 ch.Nell-girl P30](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0030)_

## Chapter XIX An Interlude

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Smudge](../character/smudge.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) talk about turning twenty and character growth before [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) joins them in her ball gown. [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) discusses her suitors and potential marriage with them before departing for her dance. Afterward, [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) briefly chat about Cressy's unique personality.

## Chapter XX Hugh Speaks

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Hector](../character/hector.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Orlando](../character/orlando.md), [Smudge](../character/smudge.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) converse in the house before [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes out to the garden. There, Hugh joins her and proposes, but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rejects his romantic advances in favor of keeping their friendship, which upsets Hugh. Later in her room, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) weeps over the altered relationship while [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) points out her foolishness.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Speaks P0](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0000), [v3 ch.Speaks P16](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0016), [v3 ch.Speaks P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 ch.Speaks P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048)_

## Chapter XXI Roses of Yesterday

The current resident shows her the east room where she was born and gifts her a bundle of old letters written by her late parents. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visits her parents' grave, reads the affectionate letters in her room, and feels deeply connected to them at last.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Yesterday P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 ch.Yesterday P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004), [v3 ch.Yesterday P15](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0015), [v3 ch.Yesterday P20](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0020)_

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) arrives home unexpectedly a day early, having walked from [Delford](../codex/places.md#delford), and greets [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) warmly before [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) rushes in to talk about his tooth, echoes, and his future marriage plans.

## Chapter XXIII Cedric Cannot Find the Rock People

She catches up with returning friends including [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) and [Belinda](../character/belinda.md), while [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) realizes he is growing out of his childhood fairyland fantasies. During a visit to [Echo Cottage](../codex/places.md#echo-cottage), Miss Rosalind gently presses [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on why she will not marry Hugh.

She recounts her health scares, introduces the eccentric older boarders, and shares her growing admiration and feelings for [Ezra](../character/ezra.md) [Hale](../character/ezra.md), an earnest young theology student.

The two connect as classmates, and [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) later sends [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a dozen roses with a sentimental poem. [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md) teases [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about her new romantic admirer, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to wonder if [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) is her true Prince [Charming](../character/charming.md).

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) then leaves Tabby's Place with [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) and arrives at the reception, where she notices Hugh chatting with the striking Rowena.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Cressida P0](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0000), [v3 ch.Cressida P1](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0001), [v3 ch.Cressida P5](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0005), [v3 ch.Cressida P9](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0009)_

## Chapter XXXII Tea with Mrs. Fairlie

**[John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Thora](../character/thora.md)** — [Thora](../character/thora.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) attend a prayer meeting where they meet [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), Thora's suitor, who walks them home. Later, John invites them to his home for tea to meet his invalid mother, where Mrs. Fairlie drops hints about John and Thora's future together while John looks deeply pained.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Fairlie P2](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0002), [v3 ch.Fairlie P10](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0010), [v3 ch.Fairlie P16](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0016), [v3 ch.Fairlie P29](../source/v03-c32.md#nw-v03-c32-p0029)_

## Chapter XXXIII “He Just Kept Coming and Coming”

**[John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Thora](../character/thora.md)** — [Thora](../character/thora.md) breaks down to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) about turning forty without [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md) ever proposing despite twenty years of courting. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) convinces [Thora](../character/thora.md) to stand up to him, but when [Thora](../character/thora.md) coldly rejects John after prayer meeting, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) immediately regrets it and rushes to bring John back.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Coming” P0](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0000), [v3 ch.Coming” P8](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0008), [v3 ch.Coming” P23](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0023), [v3 ch.Coming” P27](../source/v03-c33.md#nw-v03-c33-p0027)_

## Chapter XXXIV John Fairlie Speaks at Last

**[Hector](../character/hector.md), [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Sam](../character/sam.md), [Thora](../character/thora.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives an unexpected and awkward marriage proposal from her neighbor [Sam](../character/sam.md), which she rejects and later laughs about with [Thora](../character/thora.md). [Hector](../character/hector.md) Ward arrives at [Wayside](../codex/places.md#wayside) to inform [Thora](../character/thora.md) that John Fairlie's mother is dying, and [Thora](../character/thora.md) returns later to report her death. Following the funeral, [John Fairlie](../character/john-fairlie.md) finally proposes to [Thora](../character/thora.md) and explains that his late mother had secretly forced him to vow not to marry during her lifetime, after which [Thora](../character/thora.md) agrees to marry him.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Last P12](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0012), [v3 ch.Last P25](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0025), [v3 ch.Last P36](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0036), [v3 ch.Last P40](../source/v03-c34.md#nw-v03-c34-p0040)_

## Chapter XXXV The Last Wexcombe Year Opens

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Smudge](../character/smudge.md)** — The girls return to Tabby's Place for their final year at [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), sharing stories, teasing [Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md) about her past suitors, and settling back into their routine. Later, on a rainy night, [Mabel](../character/mabel-colby.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) combat their study fatigue by reviewing old, dramatic [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club) tales. Re-reading an old piece she wrote at [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) feels inspired to take a new step.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Opens P0](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0000), [v3 ch.Opens P28](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0028), [v3 ch.Opens P30](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0030), [v3 ch.Opens P44](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0044)_

## Chapter XXXVI The Gardners’Call

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Magog](../character/magog.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md), [Smudge](../character/smudge.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receives news that her short story was accepted by a magazine, which she celebrates with her housemates at Tabby's Place. Later, during a walk, [Cyril](../character/cyril-lisle.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that his family will visit her, though they unexpectedly arrive a day early on Friday. The visit is full of awkward moments, including cats jumping on Mrs. Lisle and Aline accidentally sitting on Honora's hidden chocolate cake, though Cyril's sister [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md) connects warmly with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md).

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P3](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0003), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P17](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0017), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P22](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0022), [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P30](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0030)_

## Chapter XXXVII Full-fledged B.A.’s

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Elias Purdy MacKinnon](../character/elias-purdy-mackinnon.md), [Honora Hollis](../character/honora-hollis.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and her friends reflect on their college experiences before taking their final exams and attending [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation). [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chooses to wear Hugh's flowers and his gift over Cyril's, but after hearing a rumor about Hugh's engagement to [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md), she angrily breaks the gift and refuses to dance with him at the graduation ball.

_Sources: [v3 ch.B.A.’s P29](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0029), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P35](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0035), [v3 ch.B.A.’s P38](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0038)_

## Chapter XXXVIII False Dawn

**[Aunt Euphemia](../character/aunt-euphemia.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md), [Mabel Colby](../character/mabel-colby.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — As the women pack up Tabby's Place in preparation to leave [Wexcombe](../codex/places.md#wexcombe-college), [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) proposes to [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) in a pavilion by the shore. Realizing at the last second that she does not truly love him, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) turns him down and breaks off their relationship. She returns to her room and tearfully confesses her decision to [Cressy](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), who initially scolds her but ultimately offers comfort.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Dawn P0](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0000), [v3 ch.Dawn P17](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0017), [v3 ch.Dawn P18](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0018), [v3 ch.Dawn P35](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0035)_

## Chapter XXXIX Deals with Weddings

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Cressy Lindsay](../character/cressy-lindsay.md), [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md), [Dorothy](../character/dorothy.md), [Gideon Duckett](../character/gideon-duckett.md), [Gorham Pullen](../character/gorham-pullen.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Inglis](../character/inglis.md), [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md), [Odette Pullen](../character/odette-pullen.md), [Simon Fletcher](../character/simon-fletcher.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Wace](../character/wace.md), [Wilfred Mott](../character/wilfred-mott.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) feeling melancholic about her broken engagement and lost youth. She visits neighbors and friends, learning about recent local developments, wedding announcements, and births, which heightens her sense of loneliness.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000), [v3 ch.Weddings P25](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0025), [v3 ch.Weddings P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v3 ch.Weddings P51](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0051)_

## Chapter XL A Book of Revelation

**[Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Harcourt](../character/harcourt.md), [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md), [Robin Farrow](../character/robin-farrow.md), [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md)** — [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) returns to [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and is shocked to learn that [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. She spends a stormy, agonizing night reflecting on her deep, unacknowledged love for him. The next morning, [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) informs her that Hugh survived the crisis and will recover, filling her with overwhelming relief and joy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 ch.Revelation P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 ch.Revelation P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P26](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0026)_

## Chapter XLI Love Takes Up the Glass of Time

**[Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md)** — Hugh invites [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) on a walk, which she defers to the following afternoon so she can finish preparing her dress for Alice Penhallow's wedding. The next day, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) walk together to [Dinah](../character/dinah-wren.md) Wren's garden, where Hugh confesses his enduring love and asks [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to marry him. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) happily accepts, clearing up past misunderstandings about [Rowena Calder](../character/rowena-calder.md) and [Cyril Lisle](../character/cyril-lisle.md) before they walk home together.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Time P0](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0000), [v3 ch.Time P15](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0015), [v3 ch.Time P22](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0022), [v3 ch.Time P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025)_
